Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You draw someone’s attention with a question while your other hand lifts the unattended key from the table.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One adjacent visible unattended object of Bulk 0 or 1.
Duration
Object transfer is immediate. The Weak Boon expires after your next attempt or at the end of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Name the object and describe your distraction. An unobserved accessible pickup needs no roll. When discovery has consequences, roll Guile:

Weak
Draw attention aside and gain 1 Boon to your next attempt to take this object before the end of your next turn. You have not taken it yet.
Standard
Take the object into your free hand without immediate notice.
Strong
Take it without immediate notice and leave a harmless substitute you already hold.

An observer can notice the missing object later. This takes only unattended objects, never held or worn equipment.
